facts: Component 1: StackDetector handles 'specfy/stack-analyser' shell subprocess execution and performs deep filesystem scanning to generate deterministic file inventories and directory structure mappings.
Component 2: ArchitectureContextBuilder parses file trees, extracts architectural signals, induces patterns via LLM, and ranks files via Fan-IN/OUT.
Component 3: SystemMapper relies heavily on LLMs. Processes payloads dynamically via 'single_pass' or partitions via 'multi_zone'.
Component 4: TechDebtAnalyzer employs local runner heuristics (Pylint, ESLint) and pushes only N top results to LLM correlation.
Component 5: DocWritingLayer is an array of 4 independent parallelized writers.
rules: SystemMapper and TechDebtAnalyzer MUST invoke LLMBudgetService to calculate chunks and approve runs BEFORE reaching out to LiteLLM.
StackDetector and ArchitectureContextBuilder MUST NEVER trigger LiteLLM API calls.
TechDebtAnalyzer MUST prioritize structural and systemic failures (God Objects, Lava flow) over standard cyclomatic complexity noise.
boundaries: Writers inside the DocWritingLayer MUST NOT perform new semantic analysis; they MUST strictly summarize or re-format knowledge outputted by SystemMapper and TechDebtAnalyzer.
Agents MUST NOT assume the repository contains clean or organized code. They must tolerate architectural ambiguity (Spaghetti code).
extension_points: Subprocess plugins can be easily appended to TechDebtAnalyzer mapping layers to support new languages (e.g. adding golang-ci lint, spotBugs).
patterns: Gatekeeper Pattern applied transversally by LLMBudgetService.
Parallel Writer processing (Scatter-Gather or strictly Scatter-Write-DB).
anti_patterns: Trying to process 'everything simultaneously'. All data MUST go through the ArchitectureContextBuilder filtration.
Prompting the LLM using a single massive generic string. Always split prompts specifically to the system analysis scope limits.
conventions: Doc Writers outputs: TechnicalDoc (Markdown), HumanDoc (Markdown), UIDoc/DebtDoc (Markdown), AIContext (Strict JSON schema).
constraints: All agents MUST use CrewAI Tasks with deterministic dependency hooks (Task 2 depends on Context of Task 1).
DocWriter 'AI Context Writer' MUST output strictly valid JSON conforming to the schema of Facts, Rules, Boundaries and Patterns.
